tytul: Hungarian lecsó in jars: why there is no recipe here
wstep: There is no recipe here for Hungarian lecsó, a vegetable stew of peppers, tomatoes and onions, canned in jars.

ostrzezenia.tekst: Pressure canning is the only recommended method for canning meat, poultry, seafood and vegetables; using a boiling-water bath for these foods poses a real risk of botulism poisoning.
Canning zucchini without pickling is no longer recommended, because research-based processing times are uncertain.
In the NCHFP spaghetti sauce without meat, do not increase the proportion of onions, peppers or mushrooms.

akapity: Most mixtures of low-acid and acid foods are also low-acid, unless their recipes include enough lemon juice, citric acid or vinegar to make them acid foods.
JarAtlas does not treat a dish as an acid food because it tastes sour, or because acid was added without a tested recipe.
JarAtlas has found no tested home recipe for canning lecsó from a checked source.
The warning about zucchini applies when the stew includes zucchini or other summer squash; the other warnings apply in every case.
